methods_considered: Regularized periodic longitudinal redistribution and winding-phase correction

split: Sectors 4,8,12,16,20,24,28,32 entirely held out; fit remaining sectors equally weighted; source spline/FFT/review historically used whole photograph, so not independent prospective validation
closure: T=floor(N/6.5+0.5), integral; exact q=N/T; periodic corrections; no omitted hidden indices
rigid: Common union of 3 separated minima per hand, 2698,2700,2833 and integrated FFT count. Equal 3 camera starts; 4 assignment/least-squares rounds, <=45 nfev each. Neighboring integers +/-3 around each hand's leading rigid count, equal 2 starts.
approximation: Ellipsoidal screen support with axial/radial ratio .7; include minor radial dot eye > -.35, 12 nearest candidates, one-to-one minimum-cost assignment; exact shell holes and occlusion audited subsequently
objective: Equal-sector mean[max(sqrt(q)-.85,0)^2 + .15*q], q=dimensionless projected ellipse Mahalanobis squared distance, plus squared regularizers. No color prior, FFT prior, free density bonus, or heldout selection.
camera: Constrained orthographic source projection; elevation 70..89.9deg, roll -180..180, translation +/-15px. No calibrated elevation or perspective claim.
centerline: Frozen existing periodic spline; camera inverse maps to planar coordinates. Source physical row pitch determines global scale for each integral T. No flexible centerline correction.
deformations: Two periodic harmonics (4 coefficients each). Longitudinal derivative coefficients +/-0.005, total derivative <=2%; integral exactly zero. Additional winding phase coefficients +/-3deg, total <=12deg, exact periodic closure. Corrections applied independently in material-index coordinate.
regularization: .15 times [dx/30,dy/30,stretch_coeff/.015,twist_coeff/(20deg)] residual vector; added squared norm. Engineering choices, not calibrated priors.
ablations: Rigid, stretch, twist, both for common union of best rigid count each hand and historical2698/2833. Corrections start at zero; same 4 rounds <=70nfev per hand/model.
audit: One-to-one exact patch-ownership reranking, training identities reserved before holdout matching. Audit all310 representatives and full existing small R201 positive patches. Preserve sparse-screen and final assignments separately. Surface-distance raster2px only for failed exact representative rays, within +/-40px. No minor-outward exposure gate.

Geometric distinguishability proxy >=25% and>=80px2, independent of color; not established photo identifiability. Include5/10/20/25/40% threshold sensitivity.
limitations: Finite search and local minima, uncertain spline/camera/source dimensions, approximate screening loss and limited surface fitting, integer T nearest nominal6.5 only, no independent observed all-visible denominator. All indices and black-region positions remain predictions.
